checks.detail: Final20084-byte source; original19869-byte source preserved separately.
Production identity fixed to publication.lock device27/inode1971855; regular-file validation precedes acquisition.
Single nonblocking acquisition; no retry or alternative mutex path in public CLI.
O_CLOEXEC plus explicit noninheritability; no child that could retain the descriptor.
Metadata-only guardian; external source/API operations remain under root's separate authorization and actual tool-handle checks.
Total monotonic deadline begins before setup; heartbeats cannot renew it.
Retained TEMP proof verifies exit124, unlock and reacquisition.
TERM/INT retained TEMP proofs; HUP shares the same inspected flag/cleanup path. No new signal/probe was executed.
finally unlock/close precedes best-effort terminal writes; journal failure cannot keep an owned live FD.
Retained case proves failed journal, fallback terminal and reacquirable TEMP lock.
The global intent ledger is file-fsynced and directory-fsynced before accepted sequence is exposed; no ACK means no external API call.
Exclusive numbered progress and terminal files; atomic replacement for mutable ledger/journal; bounded JSON.
Progress helper waits up to3seconds for the exact operation ACK and keeps checking metadata lease conditions.
Actual execution-service session_id is an explicit operator precondition; guardian PID is never a substitute.
Resolved false-negative/false-positive PID liveness inference.
Hold adds only diagnostic/required-check flags; inspect removes PID probe. Mutex, ledger, ACK, deadline and cleanup bodies otherwise unchanged.
Pure TEMP metadata/trap test covers inaccessible or reused local PID plus unchanged request/heartbeat/deadline checks.
No new guard process, signal, namespace inspection, production EX or provider call.
Historical source is explicitly mapped to the archived pre-fix file; old test result is unchanged.
Existing lifecycle tests were read/bound, not repeated.
Local timeout/release is not remote cancellation; persistent shared unresolved state blocks a normal later guardian.
Further begin refused while prior operation remains unresolved.
Reconciliation mode permits only updates to the matching existing unresolved operation, never a new save or source operation.
Updates must keep the same operation ID and cannot alter already-bound commit/archive/version/deployment identities.
Terminal clear requires a regular sanitized evidence file with exactSHA256 and bounded size; operator verifies its provider meaning.
A claim of no external start cannot clear the block through ordinary mode.
Fresh external run directory required; old journal/terminal remains preserved.
Retained fixture verifies native IDs, unresolved status, next normal refusal and unchanged ledger.
Public CLI has no custom lock/inode/ledger/duration override; production journals stay outside checkout.
All test IDs/provider receipts are TEMP protocol fixtures; no production publishing or audience mutation test.

resolvedFindings.finding: The guardian PID belongs to another execution namespace. os.kill(pid,0) from a later inspect command could reject a live guardian or accept an unrelated local PID.
resolvedFindings.resolution: Removed all PID probing; PID is diagnostic only. Inspect checks held state, exact request, fresh heartbeat and unexpired deadline, and explicitly requires the root's independent real tool-session check.

operatorRequirements: Use only after actual5Ccost acceptance, release of its cost quiet request and the required final source/build/evidence gates.

Record the real execution-service session_id from the hold launch and verify that actual session is alive before each source/API/poll phase. inspect alone is metadata validation, not execution-service liveness.

Wait for the successful exact begin ACK, then recheck actual session and fresh request/heartbeat/deadline before making the separate external call. No ACK or insufficient remaining lease means no call.
Persist actual provider version/deployment IDs and observed states. A pending deployment or uncertain transport response never authorizes repeating save/deploy.

After local expiry, error or release, retain unresolved shared ledger state. Obtain actual read-only provider observations and use reconciliation-only to update the matching existing operation before considering a new operation.
Collect actual guard terminal tool output and terminal metadata after release; a release request alone is not completion.
Keep the existing publication mutex and unresolved ledger intact; do not delete, replace or bypass either to obtain another attempt.
scopeLimits: This is independent source/receipt review, not a production guardian launch or provider-publication result.
No EX on the production publication mutex, source opening, credential input, API call, Git/build/cost/native operation, process signal or /proc inspection was performed by this reviewer.
The ten lifecycle cases are retained evidence for unchanged bodies. The narrow PID correction is covered by the separate8-check pure test; neither set was rerun by this reviewer.
Only cooperative publishers obeying the same shared ledger are contained. The guardian cannot fence an already issued remote request or stop an API running elsewhere.
The guardian checks terminal evidence bytes/identity, not the semantic truth of a provider response; the operator must retain and correctly interpret actual provider observations.

Monotonic deadline handling bounds normal operation; hard real-time filesystem persistence cannot be guaranteed. Optional outer watchdog and actual terminal collection remain appropriate as documented.

Historical implementation-receipt.json binds the pre-fix version. The old guard source and original test receipt are preserved explicitly; README and operator-contract were intentionally corrected and are pinned in their final versions.
Publication review is separate from the already completed93-subject coordination-v3 cost review. No cost input or earlier review was changed.
qualification: The corrected helper is suitable for the documented cooperative publication protocol, conditional on real tool-session checks and observed provider evidence. This review does not authorize a provider call, establish cost acceptance or assert a publication outcome.
